lesson: The system is consistently entering short positions during local oversold conditions or liquidity sweeps, failing to account for mean reversion in a high-volatility regime. By ignoring the Wyckoff 'Spring' potential at support levels, the model is repeatedly catching falling knives that lack sufficient bearish follow-through.
adjustment: Implement a mandatory 'RSI-filter' that prohibits short entries when the 15m RSI is below 30, regardless of the broader bearish trend alignment.
methodology_flag: Trust momentum-based trend following less on AVAXUSDT during high-volatility phases.
